payload.title: Publish deterministic report evidence before diagnosis
payload.description:
As a stakeholder, I want completed ranking and assessment evidence published before semantic diagnosis finishes, so that a living report reflects durable progress during long model work.

Out of scope: per-score workbook publication or changing ranking and diagnosis algorithms.

Feature: Living report milestone ordering

  Scenario: Publish deterministic evidence before semantic diagnosis
    Given exhaustive ranking and all deterministic assessments complete
    When semantic diagnosis begins
    Then the ranking and assessment milestone has already been published
    And diagnosis evidence is published only after diagnosis completes

  Scenario: Diagnosis fails after deterministic evidence is published
    Given the ranking and assessment milestone is durable
    When semantic diagnosis fails
    Then the existing milestone remains visible
    And the run reports the diagnosis failure without relabeling prior evidence as incomplete
